ggsegNeuromorphometrics 1.0.0
  • Reference
  • Changelog
Neuromorphometrics maximum probability tissue labels, derived from the MICCAI 2012 Grand Challenge and Workshop on Multi-Atlas Labeling and distributed with SPM12, for the 'ggseg' ecosystem. Provides cortical and subcortical 'ggseg_atlas' objects with both 2D polygon geometry and 3D vertex indices, for use with 'ggseg' and 'ggseg3d'. The label data are released under CC BY-NC; MRI scans originate from the OASIS project and the labeled data are provided by Neuromorphometrics, Inc. under academic subscription.
